image_identity.finding: Same colored poster composition: identical left twin-gabled log inn/wolf sign, right two-storey Miller building and wing, bridge horseman, foreground canoe/camp and two standing men, 1891 map, population table/Columbian tribute and printed publisher/caption. Different digital resolution/compression, not asserted byte-identical.
image_identity.primary_exhibit_documentary_identity: The exhibit title, George Davis credit, Poole collection, ca1893 publisher and long verbatim lower caption uniquely match the current Newberry poster.

Direct image bytes from that original link were not obtained; Commons supplies a visually matching source-attributed copy, not a substitute primary rights authority.

cleared_1857_comparison.finding: Directly viewed; the circular Miller1857 vignette is a different rendering/composition from this rectangular color poster. It does not by itself establish this poster as an unchanged reprint.
